# Code of Conduct

## Our Standards

We expect all contributors and collaborators to:

- Be respectful and constructive in all communications
- Give and receive feedback professionally
- Focus on the work, not the person
- Handle user data and sensitive financial information responsibly

## Unacceptable Behaviour

- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks
- Leaking user data, credentials, or internal system information
- Deliberately introducing vulnerabilities or malicious code

## Enforcement

Violations may result in removal from the organization.
Report issues to **team@ajoti.com**.
